sources.a: label definitions: SLURP intent / entity-type names (configs/slurp_label_inventory_train.json, sha256 a3e86457fafa4aaf60f28654f3778a278b29132068977285b3996c46773880e9) and the 31 FSC (action, object, location) triples
sources.b: frequency in FSC TRAIN annotations (data/fsc/source/fluent_speech_commands_dataset/data/train_data.csv, 23,132 records): count = number of train records whose transcription contains the word, by label
sources.excluded: no model output of any kind was used to define or adjust any rule

applies_to: model structured output only: parsed intent and entity values (normalize_v2, whole-word match inside each value); the transcript field is NOT used

object_keywords.rule: first entity (output order) whose normalized value contains one of the words below as a whole word determines the object; keywords = FSC train words with >= 95% of their records in one object class and >= 20 records that name the object or its degree; function words and verbs are not keywords (listed under object_keywords_rejected)

lights.note: singular 'light' never occurs in FSC train (0 records) and is not a keyword

heat.basis: b (only words occurring in FSC train sentences whose object is heat)

music.note: no keyword; object music only via the play_music default

object_keywords_rejected.rule: >= 95% concentrated but not a name of the object or its degree (verbs, function words, carrier words); listed for transparency, not used

object_tie_rule: if one entity value contains both a lights and a lamp keyword, object = lamp (no FSC triple has both; basis a); otherwise the first matching keyword in the value in the order of the object list above

location_keywords.rule: first entity value containing one of the words (whole word); none if no match

intent_to_action.rule: action and default object from the parsed SLURP intent; default object used only when no object keyword matched

iot_hue_lightchange.basis: a (colour change has no FSC action)

iot_wemo_on.basis: a; no default object (project lead decision)

iot_wemo_off.basis: a; no default object (project lead decision)

play_music.basis: a + b ('play' 285/285 records are activate music)

audio_volume_mute.basis: b ('mute' occurs in 99 FSC train records: 99/99 action decrease, object volume)

*.basis: a (the remaining 44 SLURP intents have no FSC action)

object_implies_action.rule: applied after intent_to_action and overrides it (in the 31 FSC triples these objects occur with exactly one action; basis a)

unmapped_policy: action 'unmapped' is a wrong action (kept in the denominator); missing object/location -> 'none'

metrics.triple: (action, object, location) predicted vs gold; 'none' compared as a value
metrics.target_any: PRIMARY: >= 1 gold slot whose gold value is not 'none' has an equal predicted value (same slot)
metrics.intent_family: descriptive: action and object equal (location ignored)
metrics.binding: two-speaker: binding_score_v1.judge on slot-value multisets D_T = T - I, D_I = I - T (non-'none' (slot, value) pairs); hit = predicted (slot, value) pairs
